question: What was the new capital founded by Sawai Raja Jai Singh of Amber?
solution: The correct answer is __**Jaipur**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • **Jaipur** was founded by **Sawai Raja Jai Singh II**, the ruler of Amber, in **1727**. • It was planned and constructed as a new capital city to replace Amber, which had become inadequate due to a growing population and water scarcity. • The city was meticulously designed by the architect **Vidyadhar Bhattacharya**, following the principles of **Indian Vastu Shastra** and **Shilpa Shastra**, ensuring optimal urban planning. • Jaipur is known as the **Pink City**, a name derived from the uniform pink hue of its buildings, introduced during the visit of the Prince of Wales in **1876**. • The city is recognized for its historical significance, architectural marvels, and planned layout, making it one of the earliest planned cities in India.
